title: Dashboard Overview
description: Learn how to navigate the Tijraa dashboard and understand its main features and sections.
content:
Dashboard Overview

The Tijraa dashboard is your command center for managing all your stores, products, orders, and settings. This guide will help you understand the main sections and features.

Main Navigation

The dashboard is organized into several main sections accessible from the sidebar:

Dashboard

The main dashboard page shows:

  • Key metrics (orders, products, customers, revenue)
  • Recent orders
  • Top-selling products
  • Quick access to common tasks

Store Management

Create and manage multiple stores from this section:

  • View all your stores
  • Create new stores
  • Edit store settings
  • Switch between stores

Products

Manage your product catalog:

  • Add new products
  • Edit existing products
  • Organize products by categories
  • Manage inventory

Orders

View and manage customer orders:

  • Process orders
  • Update order status
  • Track shipments
  • Generate invoices

Customers

Manage your customer database:

  • View customer profiles
  • See order history
  • Manage customer accounts

Store Switcher

If you have multiple stores, use the store switcher in the header to quickly switch between stores without logging out.

User Menu

Click on your profile picture or name in the top right to access:

  • Profile settings
  • Account settings
  • Logout

Next Steps

Now that you understand the dashboard, learn how to create your first store.
